d: Anand Mohan ki rihaee radd hone ke bad bihar ki rajniti men bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. Pappu Yadav ne is mamle ko lekar BJP par nishana sadhte hue dava kiya ki BJP ki vajah se Anand Mohan ki rihaee radd huee hai. unhonne is pure ghatnakram ko lekar apni bat rakhi aur iske pichhe ki vajah bataee.
